scope.purpose: Supply the empirical p99 single-slice persistent-candidate posterior-change rate bound omitted from the c67e853 freeze.

computation.seed_policy: The complete frozen development open_seed_block was rerun.
computation.persistent_candidate: P (index 2 of the frozen [T, D, P] candidate order)
computation.change_definition: For every score_history trajectory actually evaluated by open_assays(), record abs(q_t(P) - q_{t-1}(P)) after every observed slice t. For the first slice of each trajectory, q_0(P) is that score_history call's declared prior; all calls in this battery use the frozen prior q_0(P)=0.25.
computation.pooling_definition: Pool every recorded absolute change from every score_history call made by the frozen open-assay entrypoint, including the 300 primary profiles, 100 high-control T profiles, four matched-statistic permutations, and the four no-event trajectories of lengths 16, 64, 80, and 160.
